name: pluggist-unified
description: Comprehensive EV charging station directory with AI-powered assistance for finding stations, checking availability, and discovering nearby deals
long_description:
Pluggist is a full-stack web application that serves as a comprehensive directory for electric vehicle charging stations. It features real-time station data, availability checking, trip planning, and exclusive deals from nearby businesses. The MCP server component provides AI assistants with tools to help EV drivers find charging stations, check availability, start charging sessions, and discover local deals and amenities.

Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase, Pluggist offers a modern, responsive experience for EV drivers and charging station operators alike.
